profile.headline: Software Engineer | UX
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I’m a frontend engineer passionate about crafting seamless user experiences. I do this by simplifying complex technical challenges and building scalable platforms.

My collaborative and practical approach leads to projects that are both intuitive for users and a joy to develop. Whether it’s refining interfaces or improving team workflows, I focus on achieving meaningful outcomes for both users and businesses.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Identity and Access Management on the HashiCorp Cloud Platform

positions.title: Brand Ambassador
positions.description:
I freelance as a brand ambassador for fun. It’s a hands-on change from remote work, allowing me to connect with people in lively, in-person settings.
• Facilitate registration and provide support for guests and executives at high-profile events.
• Engage attendees through interactive activities, energizing fan spaces and managing event flow.
• Support operations and concierge services to ensure a seamless experience for guests across global conferences, shows, and industry summits.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Guest Relations · Branding · Airtable · Special Events · Concierge Services

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description:
During this time, I focused on building my skills and pursuing roles aligned with my career goals. I earned a Google Conference Scholarship to attend the Grace Hopper Celebration and participated in events like Women Impact Tech and Google DevFest to actively engage with the community.

I also completed Google’s Project Management course, along with Barbara Oakley’s "Learning How to Learn" and "Mindshift" courses—each of which complemented my technical work by building skills for working more effectively. From coding challenges and fullstack projects to expanding my network, this period has helped me become a more skilled engineer and a more thoughtful, collaborative colleague.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Teams: Inquiry to Lease, Design System, Platform Experience, Front End
• Built VTS’ first design system and established UX principles for a visually cohesive and scalable brand.
- Created reusable components and interactive configuration pages. Also implemented key foundational elements like color, typography, and icons.
- Streamlined integration processes by maintaining 3 internal libraries: tailwind-presets, style-dictionary (semantic design tokens), and components.
- Actively documented best practices and usage guidelines to facilitate adoption.
• Led the migration from Highcharts to Chart.js, resulting in $120k annual cost savings and improved onboarding. Conducted detailed evaluations of 3 charting libraries to determine which best meets data visualization needs.
• Revamped 47 filters and implemented unit and integration tests with Jest & RTL.
• Redesigned the navigation UI, reducing navigation elements by 25% and boosting discoverability for 45k users.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · Ruby on Rails · React.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · SASS

positions.title: Software Engineer - Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
• Led software engineering teams as a technical mentor and agile project manager to successfully complete project sprints.
• Mentored 37 students on data structures, algorithms, and debugging strategies.
• Conducted coding interviews in JS & Python to assess candidates on computer science fundamentals.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Project Management · CSS · HTML · JavaScript · Node.js · Redux.js · Express.js

company.name: The Grace Hopper Program at Fullstack Academy

positions.title: User Researcher, CX
positions.description:
• Screened 250 participants and led user interviews to evaluate individuals’ behaviors, test assumptions, and identify pain points to improve services and ship new products.
• Resolved 300+ inquiries from doctors, pharmacies, and patients.

positions.title: Project Manager | Design, Monitoring & Evaluation
positions.description:
World Vision is a humanitarian, development and advocacy organization with nearly 40,000 staff working in 100 countries around the world to overcome poverty, inequality and injustice.
• Assessed 11 evaluation reports to strategically allocate resources to 5-year projects in 14 countries, focusing on child protection, nutrition, food security, and WASH (water, sanitation, and hygiene).

positions.title: English Instructor
positions.description:
• Designed one full academic year English proficiency curriculum for 900+ high school students, and fostered mutual understanding through cultural exchange. 
• Recipient of the Ameson Outstanding Ambassador Award.

company.name: Ameson Education and Cultural Exchange Foundation

positions.title: Research Scholar - Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Configured the Senior Tracking, Analysis, and Reporting System (STARS) to streamline data retrieval for 160 older adults, resulting in efficient storage of survey results and centralized electronic record management of personal health information.
• Conducted organized home visits in NORC designated areas as a key component of the Health Indicators Initiative led by the United Hospital Fund, effectively assessing the communities' current health status.

positions.title: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease Research Assistant
positions.description: • Conducted clinical trials to examine the effect of a low-glycemic index diet plan for treating patients with Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease.

positions.title: Patient Experience Intern
positions.description:
• Surveyed patients on floor rounds to maintain high quality care, and provided action-oriented recommendations to further develop materials and practices.
• Handled inquiries related to hospital treatment and assessed patient satisfaction.

positions.title: Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
• Maintained inventory control and logged sample drugs to enforce neatness and accuracy in dispensing medications. 
• Filled prescriptions and detailed proper medication use to ensure patients’ full understanding.

company.name: Dr. Garabed A. Fattal Community Clinic

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
• Supervised a 15 member team through projects on Hepatitis B education, Making Strides Against Breast Cancer and Keep Flushing Clean awareness campaigns.
• Fundraised over $1700 for Making Strides Against Breast Cancer.
• Facilitated the “Hepatitis B Workshop” to at-risk populations on World Hepatitis Day.

honors.title: Google Conference Scholar
honors.description:
At Google, we believe a diversity of attributes, experiences, and perspectives are needed to build tools that can change the world. This Google Conference Scholarship is awarded to the most qualified persons based on application review.

Selected to attend the Grace Hopper Celebration.

honors.title: Full Stack Web Development Teaching Fellowship
honors.description: A competitive fellowship awarded to individuals with the strongest combination of a passion for coding and technical abilities.
